preconditions.description: The number of operators n is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(line) <= 20 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each type name in the operators is between 1 and 20 lowercase Latin letters.

preconditions.expression: all(line.split()[0] in ['typedef', 'typeof'] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
all(len(line.split()) == 3 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] == 'typedef')
preconditions.description: Each 'typedef' operator has exactly three parts: 'typedef', type A, and type B.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] == 'typeof')
preconditions.description: Each 'typeof' operator has exactly two parts: 'typeof' and type A.

preconditions.expression: all('B' not in line.split()[2] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] == 'typedef')
preconditions.description: The type B in 'typedef A B' does not contain asterisks or ampersands.

preconditions.expression: all(line.split()[2] not in ['void', 'errtype'] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] == 'typedef')
preconditions.description: The type B in 'typedef A B' is not 'void' or 'errtype'.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value.splitlines()[i] in ['void', 'errtype'] + ['void' + '*' * n for n in range(11)] for i in range(len(stdin.splitlines()[1:])) if stdin.splitlines()[1:][i].split()[0] == 'typeof')
postconditions.description: The output for each 'typeof' operator is either 'void', 'errtype', or 'void' followed by 0 to 10 asterisks.
